core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gulchin is a Persian-origin name meaning “Flower-gatherer, flower-picker”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gulchin corresponds to the Persian form گلچین (Persian گلچین (golchin) 'flower-gatherer, flower-picker'). Its core sense is flower-gatherer, one who selects flowers. Gulchin is the Persian گلچین (golchin) — گل 'flower' + چین 'gatherer/selector' — 'flower-gatherer, one who selects flowers', used as a feminine name. The source supplied only Latin strings and glossed it 'rose garden'; the 'flower-gatherer' sense is the correct reading.
